message: 新しい本物

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey Synn, what kind of vibe are we going for with the Holy Night Festival?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sparkly, of course!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmm, I can't really picture that. Sakura-kun, try being a little more specific」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, how do I put it, like everyone participating shines beautifully, glows super bright, and goes 'yay, yay!' or something?」

name: Misa
message: 「Excuse me?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「F-For some reason, an extraordinarily surreal image just popped into my head……」

name: Misa
message: 「Besides, why are you phrasing it as a question? You're the president, so get it together!」

name: Synn
message: 「Urk…… I-I've only got a vague idea so far……」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh? Come to think of it, where's Roro-chan?」

name: Ria
message: 「It looks like Lolotte-chan had some errands to run, so she headed home early」

name: Ria
message: 「And so, Synn-kun, I am acting as temporary secretary for today's meeting. Ahem!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, okay……?」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, you can't just stay quiet…… Bad boy!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Since you took the lead for the first time in a while, Senpai, I assumed you wanted to chair the meeting」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh dear? Quite the opposite~」

name: Ria
message: 「Of course I'm emotionally invested in the Holy Night Festival too. But only as a regular participant, I'd say」

name: Ria
message: 「The Student Council belongs to Synn-kun's generation now. So today, my lips are zipped♪」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Senpai?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even when she's acting all prim and proper, Ria-chan is super charming」

name: Misa
message: 「Pikyuun! Sakura-kun, let's compete to see who gets to be the chairperson!」

name: Synn
message: 「In that case, let's cancel today's meeting」

name: Misa
message: 「Wha--?! Are you saying you're dissatisfied with me? Humph, fine, I'll take that as a declaration of war」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn and Misa have been at each other's throats forever, haven't you」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not like that. It's just that we haven't even decided on a proper agenda, so let's take it easier this time」

name: Synn
message: 「If we just relax and bounce ideas around casually about the Holy Night Festival, don't you think some good ones will come up?」

name: Misa
message: 「B-Bounce ideas around like comedians... We aren't entertainers, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, pouring our budget into inviting celebrities is another option」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Not a bad idea, though wouldn't that work for pretty much anything, not just the Holy Night Festival?」

name: Misa
message: 「Exactly. Sakura-kun, do you even understand the meaning of the Holy Night Festival? It's a sacred festival celebrating Christmas, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「That's literally just what it sounds like」

name: Misa
message: 「Ngggh...!」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hmph, even though this is a mission school, there are still plenty of people who don't really understand Christmas」

name: Misa
message: 「So this year, let's make it a Holy Night Festival that captures the feel of an authentic, traditional Christmas!」

name: Synn
message: 「...In terms of having a vague image, you're pretty much in the same boat as me」

name: Misa
message: 「Mmph, mine is way more concrete! I'll go research it at the library right now, you'll see!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hold on a second!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Listen, just because something is 'authentic to its homeland' doesn't mean everyone's gonna love it, y'know?」

name: Synn
message: 「You think so? I feel like learning about the real thing would be pretty useful, though?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's right there, Synn! 'Authentic to its homeland' and 'the real thing' are toootally different!」

name: Misa
message: 「I don't really get it...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Um, well then, let me explain using sweets as an example」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A pastry chef I know went to France to train in making pastries and just came back」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That person had enough skill and sensibility to get the stamp of approval from a top-tier shop in France.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「They opened their shop full of confidence and recreated the authentic taste down to the last detail, but...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It didn't sell at all.」

name: Misa
message: 「Well, of course not.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why? The cakes were super delicious, weren't they?」

name: Misa
message: 「Shops in France make sweets for customers who live in France, you know?」

name: Misa
message: 「If you do the exact same thing in this country, it's bound to end in failure.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Exactly! The point is how you elevate it in your own way after studying the authentic recipes. That's what becomes the 'real thing' for that shop.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see, it's just like Yuugiri-an, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「You have fans who come from far away to eat your soba, but your main customers are the people of Ryuusei Town.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「To put it even more strictly, our main customers live within a two-kilometer radius of our shop!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So if we ever tried cutting corners, we'd lose our livelihood in an instant!」

name: Misa
message: 「I understand, Nanaka―san. We―」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, let's make a Holy Night Festival that's the 'real thing' for us... for Ryuusei Academy!」

name: Misa
message: 「Kgh! That's what I was about to say!」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I won't lose!」

name: Misa
message: 「KiraFes was a huge success and got everyone so hyped--that's our 'real thing.'」

name: Synn
message: 「Back then, everyone worked their hardest thinking, 'Let's make it even more fun!'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What are you talking about? You were the main one going all out!」

name: Misa
message: 「Right... The Holy Night Festival is usually solemn, so let's add some fun to it.」

name: Misa
message: 「First off, hymns are a must!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, we do that every year.」

name: Misa
message: 「No, this year I don't want it to just be the choir--I want everyone else to join in and sing together.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh, that sounds like it'll really get everyone excited!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa is the captain of the choir...」

name: Synn
message: 「I know! Let's go around asking people who are always dedicated to something what kind of things they want to try at the Holy Night Festival. It'll definitely be helpful」

name: Misa
message: 「Let's go!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, how's that? I said it before you did, Sakura-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't really mind, though...」

name: Misa
message: 「What's with that! Act more frustrated!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Me, me! Well then, first up is a proposal from the Sweets Club!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come to think of it, I was using sweets as an analogy earlier, so how did it end up turning into soba noodles at the end?」

name: Synn
message: 「Aren't they pretty much the same thing? Mont Blanc has soba noodles on top of it, after all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whaaat!?」

name: Misa
message: 「S-Sakura-kun, those aren't soba noodles, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「No way, no matter how you look at it, those are noodles. I've never eaten one, but I can tell at least that much. You're trying to trick me, aren't you, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「How rude! In that case, I'll make one for you next time!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I―I'll make―I'll go buy one from Cafe Rose Blanche for you!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ufufufu, setting the Mont Blanc aside, everyone is actually holding a proper meeting」

name: Ria
message: 「Silent treatment is over! I'm going with everyone too」
